title: Use the Day 2 training agenda to locate the live surfaces for message flow, database, API, Ignition, and services
summary: Use the Day 2 agenda items (Message Flow, Database, API, Ignition, Service) to orient where to look for operational evidence on the live OptiSweep system. The source indicates Confluence pages will be provided to break out these topics for better viewing.
when_to_use: When you need to quickly orient to which live system areas correspond to the Day 2 topics—Message Flow, Database, API, Ignition, and Service—so you can gather the right operational evidence during troubleshooting.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a step-by-step troubleshooting guide for any specific fault, because the source only provides an agenda/orientation and does not include concrete live-check steps for each surface.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Use the Day 2 agenda topic list to find the corresponding Confluence pages/sections and identify which live surfaces to check for evidence.
access_or_tools_needed: Confluence pages referenced by the training material

access_required: Access to the Confluence pages referenced by the Day 2 training material

steps.title: Open the provided Confluence pages for the Day 2 topics
steps.purpose: Get the broken-out topic pages that map the Day 2 agenda items to the live surfaces you should check.
steps.instruction: Open the Confluence pages that the Day 2 session indicates will be provided for better viewing of the topics.
steps.expected_result: You have access to Confluence sections/pages that correspond to the Day 2 topic breakdown.
steps.healthy_condition: The Confluence content is available and clearly organized by the Day 2 topics (Message Flow, Database, API, Ignition, Service).
steps.failure_condition: Confluence pages are unavailable or do not clearly map to the Day 2 topics.

actions.label: Open Confluence pages
actions.exact_action: Open the provided Confluence pages for the Day 2 topics (the source says Confluence pages will be provided broken out for better viewing).

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Transcript/OCR that lists the Day 2 topics (Message Flow, Database, API, Ignition, Service) and the note that Confluence pages will be provided broken out for better viewing.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Confluence pages are not available or do not clearly map to live surfaces, stop and request the missing access/materials from the training owner/support lead.

steps.title: Locate the sections corresponding to Message Flow, Database, API, Ignition, and Service
steps.purpose: Identify the exact Confluence sections that correspond to each Day 2 agenda topic so you can map them to live evidence locations.
steps.instruction: Within the opened Confluence content, locate the sections for: Message Flow, Database, API, Ignition, and Service.
steps.expected_result: You can point to the Confluence sections for each of the five topics.
steps.healthy_condition: Each of the five topics is present as a distinct section/page area in Confluence.
steps.failure_condition: One or more topics are missing from Confluence or cannot be found as distinct sections.

actions.label: Find topic sections
actions.exact_action: Locate the section(s) corresponding to: Message Flow, Database, API, Ignition, and Service.

stop_or_escalate_if: If any topic section cannot be located, stop and request the missing Confluence content/access from the training owner/support lead.

steps.title: For each topic, note which live surface the Confluence page points to
steps.purpose: Create a quick mapping from each Day 2 topic to the live system area you should check for operational evidence during troubleshooting.
steps.instruction: For each topic (Message Flow, Database, API, Ignition, Service), read the Confluence section and note which live surface it points to so you know where to gather evidence.
steps.expected_result: You have a topic-to-live-surface mapping for all five topics that you can use during troubleshooting.
steps.healthy_condition: Each topic’s Confluence section explicitly indicates the live surface(s) to check (e.g., the relevant live area for evidence collection).
steps.failure_condition: Confluence sections do not clearly indicate the live surfaces to check for one or more topics.

actions.label: Record live-surface mapping
actions.exact_action: For each topic, note which live surface the Confluence page points to so you know where to gather evidence during troubleshooting.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Confluence pages do not clearly map to live surfaces, stop and request the missing access/materials from the training owner/support lead.

success_criteria: You can identify Confluence sections for Message Flow, Database, API, Ignition, and Service.
For each of the five topics, you can state which live surface(s) to check for operational evidence.
healthy_conditions: Confluence pages are accessible and clearly broken out by the five Day 2 topics.
Each topic’s Confluence section provides an explicit mapping to the live surface(s) for evidence gathering.
failure_conditions: Confluence pages do not clearly map topics to live surfaces.
escalation_guidance: If Confluence pages are missing/unavailable or do not clearly map to live surfaces, stop and request the missing access/materials from the training owner/support lead.
missing_details: The packet does not include the actual Confluence page URLs/identifiers or the specific live surfaces each Confluence section points to; it only states that Confluence pages will be provided broken out for better viewing.
quarantine_reasons: not a live runbook: instructions cite source/OCR/training playback; end users do not have the training source
expected results are not concrete/observable on a live surface
